ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the maize plants all died, what would happen to the chickens?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has a maize plant (corn/maize plant), with sunlight above it pointing to it with an arrow; below the maize plant there is an arrow pointing to the text “Corn for feeding chicken” (corn for chickens to eat), and beside/below it there is a drawing of a chicken. This indicates that the corn produced by the maize plant is the food source of the chicken. Reasoning: If all maize plants died, there would be no corn for the chicken to eat; a reduction in the food source would cause the number of chickens to decline. Therefore, the chickens would decrease.
